reason: I might tap that TikTok out of curiosity, but I am not making an account for a site that cannot tell me if I actually qualify and then sends me somewhere else to fill out a form I will never finish.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? The listings are unverified and I still have to file on some other website myself.
would_change_my_mind: If it already knew a store or account I actually use, showed me the official notice that matches, and filed it before I forgot. A list I have to hunt through is just another tab I will never open again.
